firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: 8-word h1 with trade + city + outcome, Price it primary plus a quieter call button, phone in header, Sample rating tag, cut-line elevation is visible and the next band peeks in. 390-first.jpg: h1 sets in 4 lines, both actions above the fold, sticky Call/Price it bar. Held at 9: h1 takes 3 heavy lines at 1440 and the proof line is a long middle-dot meta string (-0.5).

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: sheet numbering now runs unbroken 00 COVER to 09 CALL, then 10 WALK-THROUGH DONE in the footer (390-full.jpg). The quote form is drawn as day cards with a film-build bar, so the signature reaches the conversion point. 1440-scroll-25/50/75.jpg: the left film stripe gains layers. Not 9.5: the services index (1440-scroll-50.jpg) and the review grid (1440-scroll-75.jpg) are the only sections that carry no drawing or sheet artefact.

type.notes: 1440-first.jpg: Sora display against DM Mono shows strong scale contrast. 1440-scroll-75.jpg: en-dash ranges, tabular mono figures, curly quotes. Held: 1440-first.jpg still has 5+ tracked mono caps labels in one view (00 COVER, RICHMOND · PAINTING, SHEET 00, CUT LINE, SAMPLE RATING) (-0.5).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: no two dark bands touch, the street break is full-bleed, splits are asymmetric and the services index is dense. 1440-scroll-75.jpg: the guarantee card now closes on a Price it button, so the empty column is gone. Remaining: 1440-scroll-50.jpg leaves ~330px of empty left column under the 'What we paint' call button beside the 9-row index.

photo.notes: Drawn treatments judged on merit. 1440-first.jpg: a cut-line elevation showing as-found vs after, honestly captioned 'Drawing, not a photo'. 1440-scroll-25.jpg: wash/scrape/prime cross-sections with legends tell the sequence. 1440-full.jpg: the rowhouse street works as the result shot. Nothing is broken or blank. Street houses vary in finish detail.

copy.notes: 1440-full.jpg: trade nouns (cornice, sills, bonding-primed, wet scraping), the 'Price it' verb used consistently, honest microcopy ('This demo form sends nothing'), Sample labels on rating, reviews, pricing, guarantee and licence. Round 5 tricolon and the 'Four short steps' mismatch are gone (dist/index.html). Every claim checks against facts.json. Held: the pre-1978 idea still appears in services, the red band and a review (1440-full.jpg).

mobile.notes: 390-full.jpg (bottom): the quote form is now one styled 'Next card' button at full width (~48px). There is no Back on step 1, no stray default button, and Day 1 card plus film-build progress fit the 390 width. The schedule is re-cut as a vertical day list, chips and checkboxes are 48px or taller, and the sticky bar is present (390-first.jpg). render.json: no overflow at 320 or 390.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg: every section and every word is present with reduced motion. dist/index.html: skip link, focus-visible, forced-colors, labelled select, form progress has aria-label, 1 h1 and no level skips. static.json and render.json clean.

motion.notes: dist/index.html: clip-in on the drawings, SplitText lines on the h1, a --sw-p film stripe that visibly builds across 1440-scroll-25/50/75.jpg, a top progress rule, and the new dayIn card transition in the form. Held: stills can't confirm one big describable scroll moment beyond the stripe.

wow.notes: 1440-full.jpg schedule section and 390-full.jpg: the coat-schedule tool outputs a taped sheet of day cards with hatched weekends and a working-day count, plus Print it and Price this schedule. The quote form (1440-full.jpg end) now reuses the same day-card and film-build language, so the tool and the conversion feel like one object. Not 10: the page stripe and the sheet bar still don't visibly answer each other.

polish.notes: dist/index.html: SVG favicon, apple-touch, og image, HousePainter JSON-LD, print CSS, forced-colors, no transition:all. 1440-scroll-75.jpg: Sample, guarantee and ZIP tags now share the 2px stamped rectangle, and the footer closes on 10 WALK-THROUGH · DONE (390-full.jpg). Minor: the dashed Sample tags and the solid section stamps use two border styles side by side (1440-scroll-75.jpg).
